basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Principal Frontend Platform & AI Engineer · Microfrontends, SDKs & Agent UIs · Distributed Systems · AWS · FinTech
basics.summary: Principal-level engineer and hands-on architect who designs frontend platforms many teams build on, now building production AI on top. At Beekeeper I owned a microfrontends and module-federation architecture across web and hybrid mobile (Android, iOS) for products used by 10M+ users, distributing shared components and reusable frameworks so teams shipped independently (one now powers 15% of all platform assets). Today at LumApps I build production multi-agent AI systems with agent-native UIs, keeping modern AI fluency close to the platform. FinTech is home turf (trading, cross-border compliance, investment research), and I lead by example: hands-on, mentoring teams, and advising on technical strategy, with distributed-systems depth on AWS and continuous delivery.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Galileo Financial Technologies (payments platform powering Fintechs and financial institutions; fraud detection, security, analytics, regulatory compliance). Principal Engineer for the design and operations of multi-channel white-labeled platforms serving on-prem and hosted customers. Lead the design and evolution of the platform; define frontend architecture standards; guide engineering teams; ensure user-facing platforms are robust, maintainable, secure, future-proof; work with product, UX, backend architects, delivery, risk, compliance, data, legal, and executives. Senior, hands-on architecture role combining strategic design with deep technical execution. What you'll do: define and evolve frontend architecture across web and mobile (web-based); collaborate on digital platform architecture; deliver engineering efficiency and standardization of non-functional requirements; advise the Director of Engineering; be an exemplary hands-on practitioner setting quality standards; define boundaries, APIs, and integrations with teams, clients, partners; operate and run software in production; architect distribution of SDKs, libraries and components to other teams; solve high-availability, low-latency, scalable distributed-systems problems; execute large-scale multi-team projects; anticipate next-gen systems; raise engineering quality (writing, testing, processes); mentor and coach across the company; advise leadership on technical strategy and org structure; drive operational excellence. What you'll need: 10+ years programming, mastery independent of language; advanced expertise designing frontend platforms including mobile, web, SDKs, micro-frontends; advanced expertise building/operating large-scale fault-tolerant distributed systems; translate product/UX into scalable solutions; continuous delivery with layered test automation; continuously improving legacy systems; strong pragmatic judgment; public cloud (AWS preferred); excellent communication (Spanish a plus); lead across multiple teams; distributed teams across time zones. Technology: deep ReactJS; Java and NodeJS; web technologies (browser internals/performance, security XSS/CSRF/auth/secure storage, REST/GraphQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3/responsive, Webpack/Vite/npm/yarn/pnpm); mobile native/hybrid (ReactNative, Cordova, Swift, Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform).
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: frontend platform architecture and MICROFRONTENDS + module federation across web and hybrid mobile at Beekeeper (10M+ users), shared-component/reusable-framework distribution (templating engine at 15% of assets), Developer Week keynote on microfrontends, large-scale fault-tolerant distributed systems on AWS/Kubernetes/Kafka, CI/CD + test automation, hands-on architect + tech lead + mentoring + technical-strategy advisory, and fintech domain (PulseView, SwissNRI, Obermatt, Opt Alpha). Honest gaps NOT fabricated: primary frontend framework is Vue, NOT React (JD wants deep ReactJS; microfrontends/module-federation/TypeScript are transferable); backend depth is Java/Python rather than Node.js; GraphQL, ReactNative, and native Swift/Kotlin/Kotlin-Multiplatform are not demonstrated; deep web-security specifics (XSS/CSRF) not documented though security-conscious; payments-specific experience is fintech-adjacent, not core payments. Zurich-based; Spanish not held.
